note: Hypothetical paper portfolio - dry-run only. Started from $1000 bankroll (not live balance). Only 4 markets cleared the genuine-edge bar; slots are a ceiling, not a target. Revisit with /self-improve once markets resolve.

trades.title: Will Paramount's takeover of Warner Brothers succeed Before July 2027?
trades.rationale: Signed definitive merger ($31/sh cash). WBD shareholders approved overwhelmingly Apr 23 2026. HSR antitrust waiting period expired Feb 19 2026 (US cleared), German clearance done, $47B equity financing committed by Ellison family/RedBird. Mgmt expects close in Q3 2026 (by end Sept), giving a full year of buffer to the July 2027 deadline. Residual ~10% risk is FCC license transfers / EU / other intl regulatory. p~0.90 vs market 83 -> +7c edge. Highest-conviction bet; sized to the half-Kelly 10% cap.

trades.title: Who will IPO before 2027? - Anthropic
trades.rationale: NO bet. As of late May 2026 Anthropic had NOT filed an S-1 (even confidentially), while rival OpenAI filed May 22. An Oct 2026 internal target is tight without a filing, leaving meaningful risk of slipping into 2027. Strong momentum ($44B annualized run-rate, first operating profit guided Q2 2026, $380B Series G, banks lined up) keeps p(IPO before 2027) around 0.70. NO at 23 -> p_no 0.30 -> +7c edge. Sized below cap given IPO-timing uncertainty.

trades.title: Will Apple release iPhone 18 before Jan 1, 2027?
trades.rationale: NO bet. Base iPhone 18 is delayed to spring 2027 per multiple May 2026 leaks; only the iPhone 18 Pro / Pro Max / first foldable ship in Sept 2026. The sibling strike 'before October' trades at just 12c, which confirms the market resolves on the BASE model (if the Pro counted, before-October would be ~85c). So p(base iPhone 18 ships in 2026) ~0.10. NO at 85 -> +5c edge. Deliberately sized below the half-Kelly cap because mis-reading the resolution rule (if Pro counts) loses the full 85c.

trades.title: Will GameStop announce acquisition of eBay before Jan 1, 2027?
trades.rationale: NO bet. eBay's board rejected GameStop's $125/sh (~$56-70B) proposal on May 12 2026 as 'neither credible nor attractive', citing financing-plan uncertainty, operational risk and GameStop governance. After a firm board rejection the path to an announced/agreed acquisition by end-2026 is narrow; GameStop holds only a ~5% economic stake. p~0.11. NO at 83 -> p_no 0.89 -> +6c edge.

skips.title: When will SpaceX IPO? - Before Jul 1, 2026
skips.reason: S-1 filed May 20, roadshow ~Jun 4, pricing ~Jun 11, trading ~Jun 12 — ~3wk buffer to Jul 1. p~0.95 vs market 97. No edge either side (NO at 4 needs p_no>0.04).

skips.title: Will McDonald's report Above 2.5% global comparable sales Q2 2026?
skips.reason: Management explicitly guided Q2 to a meaningful deceleration from Q1's 3.9%; April comps slightly negative (tough Minecraft promo comp). Market correctly prices ~1.8% median comp. My prior-run 58% estimate was wrong — the market knew the guidance. No edge.

skips.title: Will the S&P 500 be above 6845.5 (positive growth) on Dec 31, 2026?
skips.reason: Spot 7581, strike at 2025 close. model_p 0.86 is exactly the S&P model_p>0.8 'loser zone' lessons flag; corrected p_yes 0.78 (subtract 8pts). Edge +2 below threshold, no catalyst. Lessons say skip.

skips.title: Will Tesla report above 450000 deliveries Q2 2026?
skips.reason: Considered a NO on over-optimistic recovery, but Europe registrations +46-67% YoY (best week of Q2 in late May), China resilient; recovery from Q1's 358k is real and corroborated by both Kalshi and Polymarket (450-475k mode at 34%). No catalyst to fade a liquid market — lessons warn against it. Skip.

skips.title: How many launches will SpaceX have in 2026? - Above 160
skips.reason: Resolution ambiguous: Falcon-only (~150 pace -> NO on high strikes) vs Falcon+Starship (~180 -> YES on them). Bet direction flips entirely on the counting rule, which could not be confirmed (Kalshi rate-limited). Skip the whole launch-count ladder.

skips.title: Best AI in Dec 2026? - Claude (Anthropic)
skips.reason: Resolves on an undefined 'best AI' metric over a 7-month horizon. Anthropic is strong ($44B run-rate, coding lead) so 64% may be fair-to-low. No tradeable edge on an ambiguous resolution metric.

portfolio_summary.correlation_note: The 3 'other' bets are independent theses: Paramount/WB is a deal-COMPLETES bet, while GameStop/eBay is a deal-DOESN'T-happen bet and iPhone 18 is a product-timing bet — low mutual correlation despite the shared Kalshi category label. Diversification was limited because genuine edge this scan clustered in event/M&A/IPO markets; price markets (S&P, Tesla) and single-stock comps (MCD) were correctly priced or in lessons' avoid zones.
